statements.statement: The service was denied under CO-197
The denial reason was that required authorization was not obtained
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of transient loss of consciousness and brief neurological deficits suggestive of a transient cerebral ischemic attack
There is concern for a cardiogenic etiology
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to evaluate for underlying arrhythmias
The service was ordered to evaluate for potential cerebral hypoperfusion
The diagnosis codes are R55 and G45.9
